content.title: How to watch Coachella 2026 at home: Stream live performances from Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter, KAROL G and more
content.text: Some of the biggest stars in pop music, including Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and KAROL G are headlining the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival this year, and tickets to the annual event are now sold out. Coachella will run for two consecutive weekends this year, from Friday, April 10- Sunday, April 12, and from Friday, April 17 - Sunday, April 19 and performers will appear live across seven different stages. If you aren't one of the lucky ones to attend in person, the good news is that you can livestream the entire thing from home for free on YouTube, which means you won't miss a single performance.Here's what you need to know about the 2026 Coachella livestream so you can watch from home.How to watch Coachella 2026 at homeDates: April 10-12 and April 17-19Location: Empire Polo Club, Indio, CAStreaming: YouTubeWhen is Coachella 2026?This year, Coachella will span two weekends in April, from Friday, April 10, to Sunday, April 12, and from Friday, April 17, to Sunday, April 19.Who is performing at Coachella 2026?Friday performances at Coachella this year will be headlined by Sabrina Carpenter and will also feature The XX, Teddy Swims, KATSEYE, Devo, Turnstile and more. Both Saturdays will be headlined by Justin Bieber and will feature The Strokes, Addison Rae, Interpol, SWAE Lee and SOMBR (and Jack White also just announced he's joining the bill, too!), and the Sunday performances will feature KAROL G, Young Thug, BIGBANG, FKA Twigs and more.Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, KAROL G and more performers will be at Coachella 2026, here's how to watch them live. (Coachella)(Coachella)How to watch Coachella for free:Coachella 2026 will stream in its entirety on YouTube, with separate channels for each stage. Live performances will begin at 4 p.m. PT on Friday, April 10. The Coachella channel will offer multiview, allowing fans to watch up to four stages simultaneously on their TV. You can also watch past performances on demand.What is the Coachella 2026 schedule?The Coachella main stage schedule for weekend one is below. For a look at performance times and schedules for the entire festival, you can click here.All times PDT.Friday, April 10, 2026Anyma (12:00 a.m., Coachella Stage)Sabrina Carpenter (9:05 p.m., Coachella Stage)The xx (7:00 p.m., Coachella Stage)Teddy Swims (5:30 p.m., Coachella Stage)Record Safari (4:15 p.m., Coachella Stage)Saturday, April 11, 2026Justin Bieber (11:25 p.m., Coachella Stage)The Strokes (9:00 p.m., Coachella Stage)Giveon (7:00 p.m., Coachella Stage)Addison Rae (5:30 p.m., Coachella Stage)Jaqck Glam (4:15 p.m., Coachella Stage)Sunday, April 12, 2026Karol G (9:55 p.m., Coachella Stage)Young Thug (7:50 p.m., Coachella Stage)Major Lazer (6:10 p.m., Coachella Stage)Wet Leg (4:45 p.m., Coachella Stage)Tijuana Panthers (3:40 p.m., Coachella Stage)Gabe Real (2:45 p.m., Coachella Stage)How to get tickets to Coachella 2026While tickets to both weekends of Coachella are already sold out, you can still find resale tickets. AXS Official resale tickets are Coachella's preferred resale vendor, but you can also find passes on third-party sites like Gametime and StubHub. Tickets aren't cheap, though; single-day passes start at $820, and three-day passes start around $2,700.Find tickets on AXS Find tickets on Gametime Find tickets on StubHub
